column1: # Fake-names build (build.py --fake-names): the game's own stand-in names in place of
# the real names used by the translation. tools/fakenames.py applies these rules to the
# English of every JP/EN text file (story scenes, menu strings, profiles) and of
# edit_wrestlers.tsv. The roster itself is in fake_roster.tsv, promotion names in
# real<TAB>fake[<TAB>when]. Whole words, case-sensitive, longest first; a space also
# matches a line break inside a message. `when` is a regular expression searched in the
# Japanese of the message, then of the whole scene; the rules for one name are tried in
# order, so the default (no `when`) goes last. A name with only `when` rules is left
# alone elsewhere. Columns starting with # are comments (roster number).
# --- Wrestlers: full name, then the name the story uses ---
